status.summary: Top flyweight contender coming off a loss. She lost 28-29 x3 to Alexa Grasso at Noche UFC (Sep 12, 2026, Glendale) after being knocked down in R1. Before that she stopped Jasmine Jasudavicius with ground punches at 1:14 of R1 (Oct 18, 2025, Vancouver) and lost a 47-48 x3 decision to Valentina Shevchenko for the flyweight title (UFC 315, May 10, 2025, Montreal). Her UFC record is 8-2, and both losses are decisions. The dataset has Natalia Silva winning a women's flyweight title bout over Wang Cong at UFC 332 (Oct 3, 2026). Fiorot's ranking, next booking and any injuries could not be checked on the web this session.

style.summary: A high-output striker who throws far more than the division average, mostly punches to the head plus body shots, and she is very hard to take down. She keeps her pace into the late rounds. Her limits are accuracy and leg-kick defence. Both decision losses came against sharper counter-strikers who dropped her once.

moves.notes: Weights follow the schema example and src/director.js: head moves sum to 1, body to 1, legs to 1; spinning, knee and elbow are separate rates for specials. Target split from fighters.json: time-decayed significant attempts are 83.6% head, 12.1% body, 4.2% legs (landed 67.1/24.2/8.7); career attempts 82.6/12.2/5.2 (landed 65.4/23.3/11.3); women's flyweight league 77.3/14.0/8.7. She throws to the head more than the division, but her body strikes land so often that they make up a quarter of what she lands. No web scouting source could be read this session, so the split inside each group is a judgment. The jab and straight lead the head group for a volume puncher. Her karate background (recalled, not verified) gives her head kicks a small share. Body kicks lead the body group as a judgment; vs Grasso at least 17 of her 19 body strikes came at distance (she landed only 2 in the clinch and none on the ground). knee 0.12 reflects the clinch body work vs Shevchenko (29 of 33 clinch strikes, 35 of 37 to the body), which ufcstats does not split by technique. Legs are split evenly because calf vs inside cannot be told apart. Medium-low confidence.

engine_notes.note: Volume: 12.9 significant attempts per minute time-decayed and 13.6 career (division 9.2), landing 5.05 and 5.56 per minute (division 3.98). She absorbs 4.08 per minute, decayed.
Takedown defence is elite: 87.5% career, 86% decayed (division 61%). Opponents' control is 44 s per 15 min, decayed (division 180).

Late rounds: in her two 5-round fights (Blanchfield, Shevchenko) her output by round is 1.00, 0.95, 1.05, 1.46, 1.46 of round 1, against a division curve of 1.00, 0.90, 1.01, 1.14, 1.32. Only two fights, but she out-landed both opponents in R5 (42-27 vs Blanchfield, 18-15 vs Shevchenko).

Chin: 2 knockdowns absorbed in 10 UFC fights, both in her two losses; 0.65 per 100 head strikes absorbed career (division 0.25). No KO loss. Knockdown power is low: 1 knockdown scored, though she has 3 KO/TKO wins.
